packet.prompt:
Read only the supplied manuscript images. Do not search for the text, open a
catalogue or edition, or consult an earlier transcription. Do not identify the
work or author. If prior context has already revealed a proposed identification
or reading, stop and report that exposure instead of calling this a blind reading.

Begin with a brief image-only layout survey. Note orientation, columns, running
titles, rubrics, enlarged initials, underlined text, and interlinear or marginal
glosses when visible. Distinguish observations from tentative interpretations
such as main text with commentary. Do not infer author, work, date, or provenance.
A tight crop may not show the layout; say so rather than guessing.

Use those features to choose a few useful spans: headings or question openings,
then connecting prose, transitions or citation chains. Keep quoted lemmata and
commentary separate. Read enough surrounding prose to make a later source match
checkable; a full transcription is not required. State which areas you selected
and which remain unread. Suggest a wider view or an adjacent crop if needed.

Transcribe those spans, preserving physical lines. Label each line with its
image filename and a line number counted from the top of that image. Keep columns
and marginal additions separate. Note overlapping crops rather than treating
repeated lines as additional text.

Retain abbreviation marks when possible. Put proposed expansions in parentheses,
uncertain readings before a question mark, and unreadable text in [illegible].
Describe visible deletions and additions explicitly. Do not supply missing words
from what would make grammatical or philosophical sense. Leave uncertainty visible.

Return the reading as UTF-8 plain text. Include limitations (cropped lines, damage,
uncertain column order) in that same response. This is an unverified image reading.

text:
packet-08 - first reader response (unverified image reading)
No identification or prior reading was revealed in my context. I followed the reader brief only.

LAYOUT SURVEY (image-001, overview of face 1)
- Three separate small paper fragments on black ground, with colour checker and mm scale. Pencil shelfmark-like labels on each: top right "Stams, STA, Frg. 180-1r", bottom right "Stams, STA, Frg. 180-2r", small middle-left piece "Stams, STA, Frg. 180-3r" (also "1.xi."? in pencil). Part of the small piece is masked by a grey rectangle.
- Script: German cursive (Kurrent) in brown ink, documentary hand, not a book hand. No columns of prose; this is a list/account.
- Fragment 180-1r (top right): about 9-10 lines of entries with numerals, fractions and money/measure abbreviations; a vertical ruled column at right with sums ("2 . 2 . 2", "4 4 4"?) after a "fl."-like sign. Looks like an account/ledger (observation: numbers, unit signs; interpretation: accounts).
- Fragment 180-2r (bottom right): about 10 lines; list of personal names at the left (each beginning with a flourished capital), dotted/dashed lines running to a right margin where an "fl"-like sign stands; lower lines longer prose-like entries. Trimmed at right and bottom.
- Fragment 180-3r (middle left): only a few words at top ("...  ..."), pencil notes; mostly blank or masked.
- No rubrics, no enlarged decorated initials, no glosses seen at overview scale.
Tile plan: tiles 002-010 are a 3x3 grid of face 1 at native resolution (rows 002-004, 005-007, 008-010). Text fragments fall in tiles 003/004 (180-1r), 005/006 (180-3r), 009/010 (180-2r) by position.

FACE 1, FRAGMENT 180-1r
image-003 (left part of fragment 180-1r; right edge of tile cuts the lines; left edge of leaf also trims first letters)
Lines are separated by dashed horizontal strokes (- - - -) used as fillers/separators between entries.
003.01 [top edge, cut] ... [illegible tops of letters] ... 2 ...
003.02 [.]waſs? . . [?]iſchen? . 14 wol?/rod? .
003.03 - - - - - - - - xr.? . i
003.04 [?]main? . ff.? . 7 . xr.? -
003.05 4 . wadſchaber? . o . wad[...]
003.06 - - - - - - (dashed filler)
003.07 3 . Agö? ſingſchaber? . D[...]
003.08 [?]r . 16 . a[?]d.? . 6 xr.? . i
003.09 Gaßl?mitt? x mal: andi? [...]
003.10 - - - - - - xr.? . 7
003.11 [?]hon? taff[?]lung? . a[...]
Notes: the money sign I render "xr." is an x-like letter with a looped r and a period (cf. Kreuzer abbreviation; reading tentative). "ff." on 003.04 is a looped f-like sign. Words in 003.05 and 003.07 end in "-schaber/-schuber"; first letters uncertain.

image-004 (right part of fragment 180-1r; overlaps image-003 at left: the left-most words here repeat the right end of 003; two vertical ruled lines at right form sum columns; pencil label "Stams, STA, Frg. 180-1r")
Line numbering continues the entry lines of 003 (same physical lines).
004.01 [top edge cut] ... ⁊? 2 ß 4 ꝗ . 1½? .
004.02 [overlap: ...4 rod.?] ff.? . 100 . aß? 12 .
004.03 [overlap: xr.?] i ß 4 ꝗ           } (brace grouping lines 02-04)
004.04 [overlap: xr.?] — ß 6 ꝗ 2? 2½?    }  fl.?/R? . . 2 . 2 . 2   (sum in ruled columns, written at brace)
004.05 [overlap: ...] o . wadt.? ff.? . 450 . aß? .
004.06 - - - - - (dashed filler)                fl.?/R? . . 4 . 4 . -   (sum in ruled columns)
004.07 [overlap: ...]ber . Dü?ſſmang?:   (word partly blotted; looks like "Di/Dü" with a mark over u)
004.08 [overlap: xr.?] i ß 4 ꝗ 29? .
004.09 [overlap: ...]g: andi? . 40 . ad?(?) 11½ .   (the "ad?" is an a with a large loop rising above it)
004.10 [overlap: xr.?] 7 ß . 5 . ꝗ 23 .
004.11 [overlap: ...]g: andi? . 20 . ad?(?) 10 [leaf trimmed/torn at "10"]
Signs: "ß" = long-s/ß-shaped sign before numerals (unit sign, possibly a money or weight unit); "ꝗ" = q-like sign with tail looping up (unit sign); the big hooked sign at the right before the sum columns (like an R or fl with a long descender) I give as "fl.?/R?". Expansions not attempted.
Combined reading of 180-1r (003+004), physical lines:
  L1 [cut] ... 2 ß 4 ꝗ . 1½? .
  L2 [.]waſs? . . [?]iſchen? . 14 rod.?/wol.? ff.? . 100 . aß? 12 .
  L3 - - - - xr.? . i ß 4 ꝗ
  L4 [?]main? . ff.? . 7 . xr.? — ß 6 ꝗ 2?2½?   [margin column: fl.? 2 . 2 . 2]
  L5 4 . wadſchaber? . o . wadt.? ff.? . 450 . aß? .
  L6 - - - - - -   [margin column: fl.? 4 . 4 . -]
  L7 3 . Agö? ſingſchaber? . Dü?ſſmang?:
  L8 [?]r . 16 . ad?(?) . 6 xr.? . i ß 4 ꝗ 29? .
  L9 Gaßl?mitt? x mal:? andi? . 40 . ad?(?) 11½ .
  L10 - - - - xr.? . 7 ß . 5 . ꝗ 23 .
  L11 [?]hon? taff[?]lung?: andi? . 20 . ad?(?) 10

image-006 (middle-centre tile; mostly black ground)
- Top: bottom of fragment 180-1r, overlapping lines L9-L11 already read on 003 (no new text; L11 again "[?]hon? taff?lung?: a..." with a tear at the left lower corner).
- Left edge: right edge of the small fragment 180-3r with letters "...ngu" at its top (rest of that fragment is on image-005).
- Bottom: top-left of fragment 180-2r: a vertical ruled line near left edge, and the first entry "Rudl?/Andl? her[...]" beginning with a large flourished capital (read on 009).

FACE 1, FRAGMENT 180-3r
image-005 (whole small fragment; crop rscratch/packet-08/crop-005-topline.jpg, 3x enlargement of its top line)
- A paper strip with a narrow folded/torn tab at left (vertical slit/tear), a grey masking rectangle covering the left-centre of the strip, a faint horizontal ruled line under the text line, pencil notes "1. xi." and "Stams, STA, Frg. 180-3r".
- Different script from 180-1r/2r: one line of a formal (textura-like) book hand, brown ink, cut through the upper part of the letters at the top edge, so only lower halves of most letters survive.
005.01 [...]m?rtat?is? / [...]ntatis?  an?tiqu?[...]   (lower halves only; second word could also be "an?gui?[...]" - minims ambiguous; the letter after "an" has a tall stroke and the next a descender like q/g)
- Rest of the visible strip is blank of ink apart from pencil; the masked area cannot be read.

FACE 1, FRAGMENT 180-2r
image-009 (left part of fragment 180-2r; one vertical ruled line near the left edge; left of the main column, faint reversed show-through/offset of writing with dotted leaders, not read)
Script as 180-1r (Kurrent cursive, same or similar hand). Each entry starts with a large looped capital.
009.01 Rudl?/Andl? her[?]m[...]   (capital with large loop; second word begins h with long descender)
009.02 Andre? wa[...]
009.03 Andre? Päy?[...] / Pay[...]   (a mark like umlaut/u-hook over the vowel)
009.04 Hanns? Pau?[...]
009.05 Aug? Vn?ꝰ? b[...]   (first word "Aug" or "Ang" with flourish; second word V-shaped capital, superscript sign over "n")
009.06 Bez?all[...]   (a large looped capital "B"? then "ı" and a small word, then "zall"; read with 010)
009.07 Pfl?egl?/Schl? [?]  W?d[...]   (blotted, heavy ink)
009.08 [crossed-out word] [?]men?  with u-hook above  - (dashes)
009.09 [faint line] ... ʒ ...  (at left in margin: "o ʒ" ?)
009.10 Von?/Vlm? ʒ? . Lan[...]  (bottom edge, lower part cut)
Note: at the left margin of lines 009.07-009.09 there are faint strokes and dotted leaders extending beyond the ruled line (possibly offset from another sheet).

image-010 (right part of fragment 180-2r; overlaps 009 at left; pencil label "Stams, STA, Frg. 180-2r" at top; right edge trimmed through a column of hooked signs; hole near bottom)
Entry lines end in dashed leaders "- - - -" running to a right-margin column where a hooked sign (same sign as the "fl.?/R?" before the sums on 180-1r) stands at lines 1-5 and 8; amounts beyond it are trimmed away.
010.01 [overlap ...]herumb? . - - - - - -    | fl.?/R?
010.02 [overlap Andr]e wachter - - - - - - | fl.?/R?
010.03 [overlap Andr]e Päyr? (u-hook/umlaut over a) - - - - . | fl.?/R?
010.04 [overlap Hann]s Paulander?/Paulaunder? - - - - | h?/fl.? (cut)
010.05 [overlap ...] Vrŭ?/Vnd? holtz?[?]rlohn? - - - | fl.?/R?
010.06 [overlap ...]zallung diſs? [?]rſchau?(u-hook) ff?[...]  (the last visible word begins with a crossed f/long-s like the fl. sign, cut at edge)
010.07 [overlap ...][?] Vnd?/Wd? holz . zum? Breab?n?/Brab?n? Vnd?  (cut at edge)
010.08 [overlap ...]men? - - - - - - | fl.?/R?
010.09 [overlap Vo]n? ʒ . Lauffauer?/Lauffanen?, als Fürdl?tragern?  (lower parts cut by bottom edge; hole interrupts after "als")
Combined reading of 180-2r (009+010), physical lines:
  L1 Rudl?/Andl? herumb? . - - - - fl.?
  L2 Andre wachter - - - - fl.?
  L3 Andre Päyr? - - - - fl.?
  L4 Hanns? Paulander? - - - - [cut]
  L5 Aug?/Ang? Vrŭ?/Vnd? holtz?[?]rlohn? - - - fl.?
  L6 Bez?allung? diſs? [?]rſchau? f[...]   (I read the first word as B + "zallung"; whether a letter "e" stands between is unclear because of a heavy blot)
  L7 Pfl?egl?/Schl?[?] Vnd? holz . zum? Breab?n? Vnd? [...]
  L8 [struck-through word] [?]men? - - - - fl.?
  L9 Von? ʒ . Lauffauer?, als Fürdl?tragern? [...]
Line L8's first word is struck through with a horizontal stroke.

Tiles 002, 007, 008 not opened: by the overview, 002 and 008 are black ground and colour checker only, and 007 covers the gap between 180-1r and 180-2r (their right edges already read on 004 and 010).

LAYOUT SURVEY (image-011, overview of face 2 = versos)
- Same three fragments turned over: top right "Stams, STA, Frg. 180-1v", bottom right "Frg. 180-2v", middle "Frg. 180-3v". No masking rectangle on this face.
- 180-1v: about 7 widely spaced lines of cursive (paler ink), right edge with hooked signs; line 1 at the top edge cut; last line at bottom edge.
- 180-2v: a ledger: heading lines at top (a date-like "16[..] ... 19" visible at overview scale), then ~8 entry lines with dashed leaders to a right block with the hooked sign and two ruled number columns (e.g. "i . 6", "2 . 4").
- 180-3v: one line of textura-like book hand at the top edge, rest blank with stains and a tear.

FACE 2, FRAGMENT 180-1v
image-013 (left part of 180-1v; a faint vertical ruled line runs down the left of the writing; pencil label "Stams, STA, Frg. 180-1v")
Two inks: line 2 darker; lines 3-5 paler brown. Lines widely spaced.
013.01 . 2 . [?]... (top edge; tops of letters cut)
013.02 Auf?/Auß? Vnd?(ꝰ hook above) [...]
013.03 dem? Paul [...]   (u-hook over a? in "Paul")
013.04 dem? Schäfft?/Schöfft? (i-dot above) [...]
013.05 dem? Gröſs?an?[...] / G̃r?öſsam?
013.06 [bottom edge: a tall looped letter only]

image-014 (right part of 180-1v; overlaps 013 at left; right edge has a column of hooked signs "fl.?/R?" partly cut; crop rscratch/packet-08/crop-014-lines3-5.jpg of lines 3-5)
014.01 [top edge cut, lower halves only] [?]um?[?]ſchen? [?]onig?/[?]ung? [?] ... ʒ? | fl.?/R?
014.02 [overlap Auf? Vnd?] Vrn?d[?] [blotted/stained word] [?]ſtift?/ſtifft? ſchwee?/ſchnee? - -  | fl.?/R?
014.03 [overlap dem Pa]ul Chamber?/Khandler? Kolmans?/Kolman al? ʒ? wyſt?/nyſt? - -
014.04 [overlap dem Sch]öfft? Hauer?/Zaun? Holzmayſter? alʒ?/als? wyſt?/nyſt?   (hooked sign at right edge, cut)
014.05 [overlap dem Gr]öſsam? Eyl?/Fyl? on? alʒ?/als? wyſt?/nyſt?   (sign at right, cut)
014.06 [a long horizontal stroke under the right half of line 5, then below it] [?]a? :  — —  (sign at right cut)  (probably a summing/total line; the word under the stroke looks like "Sa:" or "Sa." with a looped S)
014.07 [bottom edge, mostly cut] [?] ... l[?]ll[?] ... | ʒ?/r?
Notes: lines 3, 4 and 5 all end with the same two words, which I read "alʒ/als wyſt/nyſt" without being able to settle the letters. The ink on 180-1v lines 3-6 is paler than line 2.
Combined reading of 180-1v (013+014):
  L1 . 2 . [?] ... [?]um?[?]ſchen? [?]onig? ... (cut at top)                | fl.?
  L2 Auf?/Auß? Vnd? [?]rn?d[?] [stain] [?]ſtifft? ſchwee?/ſchnee? - -      | fl.?
  L3 dem? Paul Chamber?/Khandler? Kolmans? alʒ? wyſt? - -
  L4 dem? Schöfft? Hauer?/Zaun? Holzmayſter? alʒ? wyſt?                     | fl.?
  L5 dem? Gröſsam? Eyl? on? alʒ? wyſt?                                       | fl.?
  L6 (under a rule) Sa:? — —                                                 | fl.?
  L7 [cut at bottom edge]

image-017 (middle-right tile: bottom of 180-1v and top-right of 180-2v)
180-1v, continuing (overlap: top of tile repeats L6 "Sa:? — —" with a long rule above):
017.01 (= 180-1v L6) Sa:? — —
017.02 (= 180-1v L7, last line, at bottom edge) [...]ʒ? diſer? Außgaben? fl.?/ʒ? [?] 14 ß 4   (a short dark ink stroke over the numbers; letters before "diſer" cut at left of tile)
       at the right edge, written vertically/turned near the cut corner: "ʒ5" / "£5"? (two characters, uncertain)
180-2v, top-right (header):
017.03 [...] 16[0?/3?]9 adi?/ad: 19 Septemb[r?]is?   (date line; "ad" with an apostrophe-like mark; the third digit of the year is an open loop, 0 or 3)

- Top: lower-left of 180-1v (pencil label; a short horizontal dark stroke/slit) and the start of its last line:

- Left edge: right edge of 180-3v strip (blank here).
- Bottom: upper-left of 180-2v (left edge has a notched/torn corner):

Correction to my 017.05 note: the word there is the end of "Wochenlohn?" seen here (same line, overlap).

image-019 (left/centre part of 180-2v; left edge of leaf torn/trimmed so first letters of each line are lost; pencil label "Stams, STA ..." at lower right; hole/burn near bottom)
Entries are names with dashed leaders to the right.
